definitions.explanation: Tomato ketchup, the condiment. Used the same way as in English.

examples.japanese: ケチャップを{取|と}って。
フライドポテトにケチャップをつけて{食|た}べる。
examples.english: I eat french fries with ketchup.

examples.japanese: オムライスの{上|うえ}にケチャップで{文字|もじ}を{書|か}いてくれた。
examples.english: They wrote a message in ketchup on top of the omurice for me.

notes:
From English "ketchup." Refers to tomato ketchup, the most common condiment variety in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ケチャップライス: ketchup-flavored fried rice
- ケチャップ{味|あじ}: ketchup flavor
- トマトケチャップ: tomato ketchup (the full formal name)
- ケチャップをかける: to put ketchup on

ASSOCIATED DISHES:
Ketchup is a key ingredient in several iconic Japanese-Western ({洋食|ようしょく}) dishes:
- オムライス: omurice (ketchup rice wrapped in omelet)
- ナポリタン: Napolitan spaghetti (ketchup-based pasta)
- ケチャップライス: ketchup fried rice

These dishes are staples of {洋食|ようしょく} (Western-style Japanese cuisine) and are very popular comfort food.
